C695  Lacrimal sac, lacrimal duct  

**Note 1:** **Site-Specific Factor 25, Schema Discriminator: Lacrimal Gland/Lacrimal Sac** is used to discriminate between lacrimal gland, staged by TNM, and lacrimal sac, not staged by TNM. Both sites are coded to ICD-O-3 code C695

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for this site.

**Note 3:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Lacrimal Gland* chapter on page 266 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=266).
